data.long_meaning: From the Greek word igeneia, meaning 'strong, firm, or obedient'. In Greek mythology, Igenia was a virgin priestess of Hera, the goddess of marriage and childbirth. She was the daughter of King Pelias and was eventually sacrificed to appease the gods. Her story is a tragic reminder of the importance of obedience and faith.
